import {
  defineApp,
  Screen,
  Stack,
  Row,
  Grid,
  Card,
  Text,
  Icon,
  Button,
  TextInput,
  Modal,
  List,
  ListItem,
  EmptyState,
  toast,
  cues,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  storage,
  type SchemaArtifact,
} from 'vc-sdk';

// Scores live in two key-value values: the players, and the stack of point changes still
// undoable. Nothing else is needed, so the schema declares no collections.
const SCHEMA: SchemaArtifact = { schemaVersion: 1, collections: {} };

type Player = { id: number; name: string; score: number };
type Change = { playerId: number; points: number };

const DEFAULT_NAMES = ['Player 1', 'Player 2', 'Player 3', 'Player 4'];

// The board opens ready to play: four players on zero until the person changes them.
function seedPlayers(): Player[] {
  return DEFAULT_NAMES.map((name, index) => ({ id: index + 1, name, score: 0 }));
}

function readPlayers(value: unknown): Player[] | null {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return null;
  const players: Player[] = [];
  for (const row of value) {
    if (typeof row !== 'object' || row === null) continue;
    const record = row as { [field: string]: unknown };
    const id = Number(record.id);
    const name = String(record.name ?? '').trim();
    if (!Number.isFinite(id) || name === '') continue;
    const score = Number(record.score);
    players.push({ id, name, score: Number.isFinite(score) ? score : 0 });
  }
  return players.length > 0 ? players : null;
}

function readChanges(value: unknown): Change[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  const changes: Change[] = [];
  for (const row of value) {
    if (typeof row !== 'object' || row === null) continue;
    const record = row as { [field: string]: unknown };
    const playerId = Number(record.playerId);
    const points = Number(record.points);
    if (!Number.isFinite(playerId) || !Number.isFinite(points)) continue;
    changes.push({ playerId, points });
  }
  return changes;
}

function Scoreboard() {
  const [players, setPlayers] = useState<Player[]>(seedPlayers);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<Change[]>([]);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [managing, setManaging] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');

  // Load once, when the screen opens.
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    (async () => {
      const savedPlayers = await storage.kv.get('players');
      const savedHistory = await storage.kv.get('history');
      if (!live) return;
      const loaded = readPlayers(savedPlayers);
      if (loaded !== null) setPlayers(loaded);
      setHistory(readChanges(savedHistory));
      setReady(true);
    })().catch(() => {
      if (!live) return;
      setReady(true);
      toast('Couldn’t load your saved scores.');
    });
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Save on every change, once the saved game has been read.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    storage.kv.set('players', players).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save the scores.'));
  }, [players, ready]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!ready) return;
    storage.kv.set('history', history).catch(() => toast('Couldn’t save the undo history.'));
  }, [history, ready]);

  const addPoint = (player: Player) => {
    setPlayers(players.map((p) => (p.id === player.id ? { ...p, score: p.score + 1 } : p)));
    setHistory([...history, { playerId: player.id, points: 1 }]);
    cues.haptic('tap').catch(() => {});
  };

  const undo = () => {
    const last = history[history.length - 1];
    if (last === undefined) return;
    const player = players.find((p) => p.id === last.playerId);
    setPlayers(players.map((p) => (p.id === last.playerId ? { ...p, score: p.score - last.points } : p)));
    setHistory(history.slice(0, -1));
    cues.haptic('double').catch(() => {});
    toast(player === undefined ? 'Undid the last point' : `Undid ${last.points} point for ${player.name}`);
  };

  const newGame = () => {
    setPlayers(players.map((p) => ({ ...p, score: 0 })));
    setHistory([]);
    toast('Scores reset — the same players play on');
  };

  const addPlayer = () => {
    const trimmed = name.trim();
    if (trimmed === '') return;
    const nextId = players.reduce((max, p) => Math.max(max, p.id), 0) + 1;
    setPlayers([...players, { id: nextId, name: trimmed, score: 0 }]);
    setName('');
    setManaging(false);
    toast(`${trimmed} joined the table`);
  };

  const removePlayer = (player: Player) => {
    setPlayers(players.filter((p) => p.id !== player.id));
    setHistory(history.filter((change) => change.playerId !== player.id));
    toast(`${player.name} left the table`);
  };

  const leader = players.length === 0 ? undefined : players.reduce((best, p) => (p.score > best.score ? p : best), players[0]);
  const undoable = history.length;

  return (
    <Screen
      title="Game Night"
      action={{ icon: 'plus', label: 'Add or remove players', onPress: () => setManaging(true) }}
    >
      <Stack gap="lg">
        {leader === undefined ? (
          <EmptyState icon="dice-5" title="No players yet" hint="Tap + to add the first player." />
        ) : (
          <Stack gap="lg">
            <Card>
              <Row justify="between">
                <Row gap="sm">
                  <Icon name="trophy" color="warning" label="Leading" />
                  <Stack gap="none">
                    <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Leading</Text>
                    <Text size="subtitle">{leader.name}</Text>
                  </Stack>
                </Row>
                <Text size="display" color="primary">{String(leader.score)}</Text>
              </Row>
            </Card>

            <Grid columns={2}>
              {players.map((player) => (
                <Card key={player.id} onPress={() => addPoint(player)}>
                  <Stack gap="xs">
                    <Row justify="between">
                      <Text weight="semibold">{player.name}</Text>
                      <Icon name="plus" size="sm" color="primary" label={`Add a point for ${player.name}`} />
                    </Row>
                    <Text size="display" color="primary" align="center">{String(player.score)}</Text>
                  </Stack>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </Grid>
          </Stack>
        )}

        <Row>
          <Button
            label="Undo last point"
            variant="secondary"
            icon="arrow-left"
            disabled={undoable === 0}
            onPress={undo}
          />
          <Button label="New game" variant="ghost" icon="repeat" disabled={players.length === 0} onPress={newGame} />
        </Row>

        <Text size="caption" color="text-muted" align="center">
          {undoable === 0
            ? 'Tap a player’s card to add a point.'
            : `${undoable} ${undoable === 1 ? 'point' : 'points'} can still be undone.`}
        </Text>
      </Stack>

      <Modal visible={managing} title="Players" onClose={() => setManaging(false)}>
        <Stack gap="lg">
          <TextInput label="New player" value={name} placeholder="Name" onChange={setName} />
          <Button label="Add player" icon="plus" disabled={name.trim() === ''} onPress={addPlayer} />
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <Text size="caption" color="text-muted">Tap a player to remove them.</Text>
            {players.length === 0 ? (
              <Card>
                <EmptyState icon="users" title="Nobody at the table" hint="Add a player above." />
              </Card>
            ) : (
              <List>
                {players.map((player) => (
                  <ListItem
                    key={player.id}
                    title={player.name}
                    trailing={String(player.score)}
                    icon="user"
                    onPress={() => removePlayer(player)}
                  />
                ))}
              </List>
            )}
          </Stack>
        </Stack>
      </Modal>
    </Screen>
  );
}

export default defineApp({
  name: 'Game Night Scores',
  initial: 'Scoreboard',
  screens: { Scoreboard },
  capabilities: ['storage', 'cues'],
  schema: SCHEMA,
  tint: ['violet', 'indigo', 'purple'],
  icon: 'dice-5',
});
